intro.text: An Invested art from Yolen that makes illusions, both images and sounds.

description.text: Its illusions can be seen and heard. An illusion can be left in one place, apart from the Lightweaver, or tied to a host; either way it needs a steady supply of Investiture.
The illusions are mostly mental creations, tied to a person's mind, and have no physical mass. They can move, but a moving image is harder to keep up than a still one and takes more mental control.

An image only holds near its source of Investiture. As the Lightweaver goes further away it blurs, and it fades out entirely once the link is lost. Concentrating harder stretches that range, but only a little.
